title: Pool Party
tagline: 💰 Make token merges for company acquisition, token migration, and general merges chill 😎
description: During migrations there are often dead liquidity left in pools by people who either have lost access to their wallets or for some other reason have decided to not remove their liquidity and migrate to the new token. Our project allows for projects that are migrating their token to take advantage of this dead liquidity in order to not leave any money on the table
how_its_made:
We make use of Flow to be able to leverage the power of multiple EVMs so that we are able to reach as many consumers as possible. The ability to connect with digital ecosystems allows us to help every token migration be more smooth for more people.

Walrus is used to store the contracts and per migration information. Being able to store this data in a decentralized manner gives our users the benefit of being sure the data is immutable and they are able to inspect it at any time.

For our off chain logic we use Oasis TEE's in order to make them secure. Using the TEE's of Oasis allows us to store our data on Walrus in a untamperable way, giving our users once again the benefit of knowing that their data is being stored as promised.
